title: A query-log delivery refused by its sync logs no reason, and kbmon raises REFUSED though another run delivered the rows
goal: When kbgit.py sync exits 2 under ql_deliver.deliver, the distill log names the refusal's reason (dirty tree, an operation in progress, another sync's lock) even when the sync printed a pushed: line, and a refusal that a concurrent run's push made moot (its rows already on origin/main, so nothing is undelivered) does not raise kbmon's REFUSED alert

run:
import os,sys;p=os.path.expanduser("~/it-ops-kb/_cache/querylog/distill.log")
L=open(p).read().splitlines() if os.path.exists(p) else []
bad=[i for i,l in enumerate(L) if "sync exit 2: nothing pushed" in l and i>0 and L[i-1].strip()=="pushed: no"]
print("refusals logged with no reason:",len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

repro_reason: the refusal happens only when two session-end distill runs overlap on the shared query-log worktree, a race no planted input reproduces on demand; the repro reads this clone's distill.log for a refusal logged without its reason

run: import sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_deliver as d;out=[];nl=chr(10);run=lambda argv,cwd=None:(0,'a'*40+nl,'') if argv[:2]==['git','rev-parse'] else (2,'pushed: no'+nl,'sync refused: another sync holds the lock'+nl);p=d.Pusher('.',tempfile.mkdtemp(),run,None,out.append,cloud=False);c=p.deliver('r1');print(c,out);sys.exit(0 if c==2 and any('another sync holds the lock' in o for o in out) else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_querylog as m;last={'outcome':'refused','why':'sync exit 2','when':'2026-11-08T10:00:00Z'};a=m.alerts({'last_delivery':last,'undelivered':0});b=m.alerts({'last_delivery':last,'undelivered':3});print(len(a),len(b));sys.exit(0 if not a and len(b)==1 else 1)

clauses.clause: When kbgit.py sync exits 2 under ql_deliver.deliver, the distill log names the refusal's reason (dirty tree, an operation in progress, another sync's lock) even when the sync printed a pushed: line
a refusal that a concurrent run's push made moot (its rows already on origin/main, so nothing is undelivered) does not raise kbmon's REFUSED alert
